linkedin.text:
We're looking for design partners for Control Tower.

If your team runs AI agents that call models, MCP tools and internal APIs, you probably have the same questions we kept hearing:
→ Which agents reach which systems?
→ What is each one costing us?
→ Who approved that tool call?

Control Tower is an open-source, self-hosted gateway that puts every agent flow on one live map, and lets you put gates on the paths that matter: block, require a human's approval, or inspect.

We want a small group of teams to build the next part of it with us. Design partners get:
• Control Tower Enterprise free: SSO, SCIM, audit log to your SIEM, agent identity, secret managers
• A direct line to the person writing the code
• A real say in the roadmap
• Hands-on help wiring up your agents, MCP servers and first gates

Interested? Email partners@agentcontroltower.app with a few lines about what your agents do.

The code: https://github.com/joshmaster2165/controltower

#AIAgents #MCP #PlatformEngineering
